Chapter 492 - 492 Forget It; Give Me A Car! (1)

Chapter 492 - 492 Forget It; Give Me A Car! (1)

492 Forget It; Give Me A Car! (1)

Not enough seats?

When Wang Yunfang heard this, she hurriedly turned around and came to the last seats. “Su Ningjing, Lin Fan, you guys came too late…

“I thought you guys weren’t coming today, so I didn’t arrange your seats.

“How about this, Su Ningjing? I’ll return the gift money to you. You guys go back first. I’ll treat you to a meal next time.”

After speaking, she stuffed the 500 yuan into Su Ningjing’s arms.

Wang Yunfang’s original intention was to show off her grand wedding.

Su Ningjing was already here. She had seen it… Wang Yunfang had achieved her goal.

Now that there were not enough seats, there was naturally no reason for Su Ningjing to continue staying.

…

Too late?

Even now, guests were coming in one after another.

This was called too late?

Lin Fan was already unhappy with Wang Yunfang.

Whenever she spoke, she kept showing off.

She even seemed to belittle Su Ningjing.

Now, she even returned the gift money and was trying to chase him and Su Ningjing away.

At this moment, Lin Fan could no longer bear with it. He stood up and said, “Ningjing, let’s go.”

Su Ningjing had always listened to Lin Fan’s words.

She stood up without hesitation.

At this moment, Zhang Zhou, Song Zhifeng, Wang Fengyi, and the others slowly walked over under Shu Rong’s personal lead.

“Hello, Mr. Lin,” Song Zhifeng, Zhang Zhou, and Wang Fengyi said in unison.

As soon as they said this, Wang Yunfang’s heart suddenly jumped.

What did she hear?

The chairman of Yinshan Group, the chairman of Xiao Wu Wholesale City, and the general manager of the Imperial Hotel all greeted Su Ningjing’s boyfriend?

This…

What was going on?

…

Seeing that Lin Fan was about to leave, Zhang Zhou asked curiously, “Mr. Lin, you’re…”

Lin Fan had already seen Zhang Zhou and the others. At the same time, he understood what they were thinking.

“It’s nothing,” he said calmly. “This bride is my girlfriend’s former classmate. However, she feels that there aren’t enough seats at the banquet.

“So, she returned my girlfriend’s gift money and asked us to leave.”

Return the gift money?

Getting Lin Fan and his girlfriend to leave?

This… It was simply a humiliation!

Zhang Zhou, Song Zhifeng, Wang Fengyi, and the others all had ugly expressions on their faces.

“Since there aren’t enough seats, let’s leave too!” Zhang Zhou said coldly.

“I agree!” Song Zhifeng said.

“It seems that the hall of our Imeprial Hotel is too small. In that case, Mr. Shu, I think you shouldn’t hold your wedding here,” Wang Fengyi said in a deep voice.

As they spoke, they followed Lin Fan and were about to walk out together.

At this moment, no matter how dumb Shu Rong was, he knew that Lin Fan was definitely an incredible figure.

In fact, Zhang Zhou and the others suddenly came to attend the wedding because of Lin Fan!

Originally, he had the opportunity to establish a relationship with Zhang Zhou, Song Zhifeng, Wang Fengyi, and other big shots.

Now, not only could he not establish a relationship with them, but he had also offended the other party!

Wang Yunfang, this bastard woman!

Shu Rong glared fiercely at Wang Yunfang and then said anxiously, “Chairman Zhang, Chairman Song, Mr. Wang… Please don’t leave, Mr. Lin. There must’ve been a misunderstanding just now…”

However, Lin Fan and the rest did not care about Shu Rong’s shouts and continued walking out.

Shu Rong could not help but shout at Wang Yunfang, “What are you waiting for? Quickly apologize to Mr. Lin and his girlfriend!”

Wang Yunfang slowly recovered from her shock and said, “L-Lin Fan, Su Ningjing, I was just joking…”

However, Lin Fan, Su Ningjing, Zhang Zhou, and the others did not stop.

When Shu Rong saw this, he could not help but shout at Shu Jiadong, “Look, this is the woman you want to marry!”

Originally, he was not very satisfied with Wang Yunfang.

Now, he was even more disgusted!

Shu Jiadong opened his mouth and slowly lowered his head.

At this moment, at the front of the banquet hall, the large LED display screen that was originally playing the wedding video of Shu Jiadong and Wang Yunfang suddenly jumped, and a 65-slide PowerPoint presentation deck appeared.

There were photos of Wang Yunfang before plastic surgery, chat records of her with many people, and all kinds of indecent photos…

Seeing this…

Everyone’s eyes widened.

Shu Rong was so angry that his entire body trembled.

Shu Jiadong was stunned.

Wang Yunfang’s face was pale, and cold sweat rolled down her forehead.

She stuttered, “J-Jiadong, these… These aren’t real…”

It would have been fine if she had not opened her mouth, but the moment she did, it seemed to have completely ignited Shu Jiadong’s anger.

“B*tch!”

Shu Jiadong raised his hand and fiercely slapped Wang Yunfang’s face.

“I’m not getting married!”

Wang Yunfang did not cry even after the slap.

However, when she heard Shu Jiadong’s words, she immediately shed hot tears.

She could not marry the factory owner’s son anymore.

…

Lin Fan did not care about any of this at all.

He and Su Ningjing did not leave the Imperial Hotel. Instead, under Wang Fengyi’s arrangement, they went to the VIP room on the 78th floor.

The two of them sat in a large private room, admiring the beautiful scenery outside the window and tasting all kinds of delicacies. They were very satisfied.

Su Ningjing’s pretty face was full of smiles.

It was not because they were in a VIP room, nor was it because of the beautiful scenery, nor was it because of the delicious food.

It was because Lin Fan was right beside her.

Then, the two of them went to KM Mall.
